pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use JEI to prepare flour and dough, then follow the Stove bread recipe. Bought bread does not replace baking.

pages.title: Fuel the kitchen stove
pages.text: The Stove uses fuel and its own cooking recipes. Its heat also supports a Cooking Pot or Roaster placed above it.
